name: Disneyland Edelweiss Snacks (Fantasyland) Grilled Bratwurst on Brioche Roll (No Sauerkraut Mod)
whyItWorks: Mild German-style pork/veal sausage on a soft buttery brioche roll—ordering it with NO fermented cabbage sauerkraut keeps it low-residue.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for the Bratwurst on the roll with **NO sauerkraut** and mustard on the side.
watchOuts: Always skip the fibrous cabbage sauerkraut during flares
